pages.title: Checkout API High Latency Runbook
pages.body:
Service: checkout-api
Team: payments
Runbook steps: check Prometheus p95 latency, 5xx error rate, pod CPU, recent deployment, database timeout logs, and downstream payment service latency. Mitigation: scale deployment in dev, request approval for prod scale or rollback.

pages.title: Kubernetes CrashLoopBackOff SOP
pages.body:
Service: kubernetes-platform
Team: platform
Check previous logs, describe pod, inspect events, validate configmap/secret mounts, and rollback if the new image crashes repeatedly.
